message: For each of these 12 CRM tools, find the current starting price, verify it on the official pricing page, and check news since Monday: HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho, Salesforce, Close, Freshsales, Copper, Insightly, Zendesk Sell, Monday CRM, Nutshell, Capsule.
